mandate_balance_failed.title: e-Mandate Setup Failed
mandate_balance_failed.explanation: e-Mandate registration failed because your HDFC Bank account ending 9012 did not maintain the required setup balance. Don't worry, your State Bank of India account ending 4521 is active and eligible. Would you like to set up auto-debit using that account?
mandate_balance_failed.action_label: Set up e-mandate on SBI account

mandate_account_invalid.title: Bank Account Inactive
mandate_account_invalid.explanation: Your destination bank reported that the selected account is closed or inactive. Please choose an active primary savings account to complete auto-debit setup.

post_closure_debit.title: EMI Debited After Loan Closure
post_closure_debit.explanation: Your personal loan was fully closed on November 04, 2026. However, an EMI of ₹4,500 was debited on November 05 due to the automated clearing cycle. We propose opening an expedited refund ticket to return ₹4,500 to your account and expediting your No-Dues Certificate (NOC).

vkyc_dropped.title: Video KYC Disconnected
vkyc_dropped.explanation: Your video KYC session was interrupted due to a network drop. Your PAN card verification is already completed. We can send a direct, secure resume link valid for 72 hours to your mobile ending 3210.

checklist.label: Sit in a well-lit, quiet area

rejection_obligations.title: Application On Hold
rejection_obligations.explanation: Based on existing active credit obligations, this application cannot proceed today. We can schedule a check in 90 days to reassess eligibility without affecting your credit score.
